notes.title: Mind Space Update 4
notes.content:
[h1]New Release: Mind Space update 4! [/h1]
We are very excited to release the newest version of Mind Space!

[h2]Truely Random and Dynamic Enviroments:[/h2]
Mind Space will randomly generate a unique campaign story every time you play. 
Selecting levels out of a larger array the game organizes random biomes.
Each biome will have unique factors, that effect player, upgrades, weapons, enemies ETC

[h2]Optimizations:[/h2]
Many. many, many game changes and bug fixes. Lowered Cost of levels generating on the gpu!
More ways to explore and interact with the world, and more battles.
Added a user controlable BGM player, no more boring sections! (creepy, sci-fi, and rock n roll!)

[h2]A.I. Improvments:[/h2]
Enemies are programed for faster moving player,
No longer will standing still bug the ai so they wouldn't fire
Ranged enemies have a 1/5 chance of running for cover, but will then hunt the player if they lose sight of them.
A.I. Spawning improved
More HP for bosses, better ending boss fight
Enemies have a loot drop chance

[h2]Animations updated:[/h2]
Shotgun reloads can now be interupted
animations for SMG and rifles improved
New footstep sound for Level 3, with more variety to sounds coming

[h2]Compass for player guidance:[/h2] 
A compass and objective marker have been added to help players not get lost in the dungeon

[h2]Player Upgrades:[/h2]
Player can use upgrade station for shiled, and HP Upgrades, with more to come
(Preview in pause menu, player can tab through possible upgrades IE fast hands reload!)

We have been working very hard to listen to the community and keep the game fresh!

[h2]Awnsered Communty concerns:[/h2]

No more zombies in training, keeping things scary!
Changed the door opening sound! No more HL2 sound alike 
More original models with more to come!
Better FPS, Smoother level loading.


We hope you enjoy the indie game dev update!

notes.title: Mind Space Update 2.0!
notes.content:
Mindspace has undergone a major overhaul. 

Weapons are now easy to use, and enemies have been updated!

More weapons than ever before! New Sword, and Rocket Launcher, and Sniper rifle!

Better Levels: Faster stream level time, better framerate, more objects, and larger rooms with puzzles and enemies!

Many other bug fixes and changes, Mindspace 2.0 brings an action packed story to life!

notes.title: MindSpace 1.5 Loadouts
notes.content:
Mindspace 1.5 is here!

Major updates to gameplay.

Now with Player loadouts:
Select primary weapon.
Select Secondary weapon.
Keep level between deaths.
Keep XP between deaths.
Boss updates.
Boss on level 2 updated.
Loot crates now hold Ammo, health, Bits, and collectables.
Buy and unlock guns.
Buy perks.
Added shields to player and upgrades.
Added player speed.
Aim sensativity added.
Melee Damage upgrades added.
XP Popup added.
AI tweaks.
Small health pack added.
Added Data uploading to tutorial.
Bits drop rate lowered.
Skip intro added by pressing spacebar.
Tutorial skip by using pause menu.

And many more bug fixes.
